dominant_breach: estate/gift/GST perimeter, dynastic trust duration, and trust-control opacity
fastest_washout: dynastic transfer shielding and control preservation

intergenerational_transfer_gate.note: High-end transfer rules and trust structures shape who can preserve control across generations while ordinary families face probate, care, and liquidity frictions.

estate_tax_gift_gst_perimeter.note: The federal estate/gift/GST perimeter must be scored by current exclusion, annual exclusion, portability, valuation, avoidance, and reporting—not nominal tax rate.

dynasty_trust_rule_against_perpetuities.note: Perpetuity duration and state trust-law variation create long-duration control/lock-in; certification requires governing law, RAP duration, GST allocation, and decanting/migration controls.

trust_beneficial_ownership_visibility.note: Trust visibility must include settlor, trustee, protector, beneficiary/classes, advisors, committees, powers of appointment, decanting, and ultimate effective control.

trust_legal_arrangement_coverage.note: Legal-arrangement coverage is required for trusts, foundations, private trust companies, directed trusts, and equivalent control structures.
